categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the manufacturing of ceramic glazes and colorants, glass and glass products, other chemical materials, and coatings including paints and dyes. Key product lines include ceramic color glazes, inks, special effect glazes, polishing dry granules, and high-value building materials such as jade crystal stone and composite crystallized stone. The company also develops phosphor materials for high-power automotive and stage lighting applications.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced ceramic glaze formulation, high-temperature melting, and mixing processes for glaze and colorant production. It has developed proprietary inkjet printing technology for ceramic inks and special effect glazes. Production involves high-temperature crystallization for jade crystal stone products and incorporates grinding and dispersion technologies for both inorganic and organic pigments. The company emphasizes process optimization to reduce energy consumption and improve product quality.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers are ceramic tile manufacturers in Asia, including Taiwan, China, Indonesia, Thailand, Malaysia, Vietnam, the Philippines, South Korea, Bangladesh, and Sri Lanka. The company serves the construction and building materials industry, supplying ceramic glazes and colorants for tiles, as well as high-value architectural materials like jade crystal stone for interior and exterior applications. It also targets automotive lighting and stage lighting markets with its phosphor products.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Asia with production and sales facilities in Taiwan, China (Guangdong, Shanghai, Shandong), Indonesia, Bangladesh, and sales presence in Southeast Asia, South Asia, and expanding into Africa (Benin) and Central Asia. It maintains localized production to serve regional markets efficiently and has plans to expand into new emerging markets globally.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates upstream and midstream in the ceramic industry supply chain, producing raw materials such as ceramic glazes, colorants, inks, and phosphor materials that are supplied to downstream ceramic tile manufacturers and building material fabricators. It also engages in some downstream activities through technical services and product customization for customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include continuous product innovation focusing on high-value differentiated ceramic glazes, inks, and phosphor materials. R&D efforts target development of new glaze formulations, cost reduction via alternative raw materials, process improvements, and expansion into organic pigment applications. The company emphasizes green manufacturing, energy efficiency, and developing environmentally friendly products aligned with global decarbonization trends. It also invests in digital inkjet technology and advanced phosphor materials for automotive and lighting applications.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of ceramic glazes, colorants, inks, jade crystal stone building materials, and phosphor products. The company also earns income from technical services, after-sales support, and strategic alliances with partners. It does not rely on subscription or licensing models but focuses on direct sales to industrial customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading ceramic glaze manufacturer in Asia, competing with firms such as FERRO (USA), BITOSSI (Italy), TORRECID (Spain), and regional competitors in China and Southeast Asia. It holds a dominant market share in Taiwan and significant presence in Southeast Asia and China. Its competitive advantages include localized production, strong R&D capabilities, comprehensive technical support, and diversified product portfolio. However, it faces pricing pressure from low-cost Chinese producers and competition from European suppliers with scale economies.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenues of approximately NT$2.415 billion in 2024, representing a 2.46% growth over the prior year. Gross profit increased by 29.54%, and net profit after tax surged by 169.90%, reflecting improved pricing, sales volume, and favorable exchange rates. The company maintains a stable asset base of about NT$4.5 billion and equity of NT$3.38 billion. It invests around 2.5% of revenue in R&D and plans continued capital expenditures for production and environmental improvements.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes stable high-quality products, strong technical R&D, and flexible customer-oriented strategies. It differentiates through advanced inkjet printing technology for ceramic inks, development of high-value jade crystal stone products with superior durability and aesthetics, and customized phosphor materials for automotive and lighting markets. Its localized production and service network in Asia enable timely delivery and technical support, enhancing customer trust and satisfaction. The company also focuses on sustainable manufacturing and green product development to meet evolving market demands.
